To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Hadoop is the best choice for distributed management of heterogeneous data.
the data placement policy is important in Hadoop for different file formats.
the Hadoop block placement policy for different file formats is the most efficient.
In summary, our research is concerned with
efficient placement of data blocks in distributed file systems like HDFS.
the problem of scheduling of jobs in heterogeneous clusters of Hadoop.
how to efficiently manage data in Hadoop cluster when data is heterogeneous.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a need of a system that can efficiently manage heterogeneous data in a cluster of heterogeneous nodes.
, the existing approaches are efficient but they can be improved in terms of efficiency and flexibility.
, the data placement policy of Hadoop is not optimal for all types of data formats.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an algorithm to schedule jobs (Applications) efficiently on heterogeneous clusters.
the Hadoop framework is not suitable to manage data in a cluster of heterogeneous nodes.
, the proposed approach for block placement policy can improve the performance of Hadoop by 20% to 50% depending upon the type of data format.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no single best solution for managing huge data and there is no one-size-fits-all solution for all types of data.
, we have reviewed the existing systems for data management and their efficiency.
, there is no universal algorithm which is efficient in all the situations, but there is a tradeoff between efficiency and complexity.
